```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (s : Set α) (f : α → α) (hf : ∀ x, f (f x) = x) : f '' (f '' s) = s := by
  constructor
  · intro x
    rcases mem_image.1 (mem_image.1 x) with ⟨y, ⟨hy, hfy⟩⟩
    rw [hf y] at hfy
    exact hfy
  · intro x
    rcases mem_image.1 x with ⟨y, hy⟩
    exact mem_image.2 ⟨f y, hy⟩
```
